body.name: Boundary-bump lift handle
body.construction: Construct \(A_{\mathrm{lift}}\) by backward mass transport from each unobserved cohort block \(C_t\) to the adjacent observed block \(G_t\), fixing row sums by calendar centering and measuring transport cost in the whitened norm induced by \(\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}^{-1}\).
